No file changes detected for version 1.5.0.

- No updates included in this release.

**Screenshot support & context intake update**

- Added explicit instructions and message templates for handling screenshots and partial conversation images.
- Now helps users provide quick, relevant context when sharing screenshots, without overwhelming follow-up questions.
- Improved reply flow for image-based inputs: automatically reads what’s visible first, then requests just one crucial detail if needed.
- Updated description and examples to reflect new screenshot decoding capability.
- No changes to reply style, personality, or conversation scenarios.

- Updated the skill description to be more concise and user-focused.
- Simplified examples and language for greater clarity.
- Improved formatting in the "Situation Coaching" response format section.
- No changes to logic or functionality—this is a documentation and instructional update only.
SEO: rewrite description for semantic search optimization
Pure reply format: no labels, no brackets, no numbers. Each reply is raw message text ready for long-press copy/forward.
Improved reply format: circled numbers, bracket-wrapped replies for easy copy-paste on mobile, visual separators
SEO: front-load Chinese keywords for vector search
SEO: optimize description with more search keywords
Upgrade to 5 reply styles per scenario
Initial release: AI communication coach for dating, workplace & social scenarios
